name: Tank front (est.): T-80U turret
description: Estimates from 630-700 mm (UK-sourced) to 860 mm (Russian-attributed), depending on how much Kontakt-5 is credited. Stand-in: a block of armour steel as thick as the estimated protection against long rods (RHA equivalent, line of sight). Real tank armour is secret composite; public estimates vary widely between sources - this is a rough guide, not data.
